summary: Two Crested Butte South residents clearing snow from a roof were buried when the roof avalanched; dug out in 20-30 minutes, one man survived and one died.
notes: Roof avalanche during the historic March-2019 loading cycle; CBAC 2018-19 annual report confirms the March-9 incident (dug out in 20-30 min, one survived, one died). Responding agency not named in sources read.
